# Get All Keys from Dictionary

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Get all of the keys from a dictionary.

## Syntax

~~~~text
keysFrom(dictionary: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
keysFrom(dictionary: Meta)
~~~~
